title: The Owl and the Cow
checkpoint: Reception Spring 2, week 4 — Learning — Phase 3: new sounds air, ure, er
note_for_grown_ups: The last Phase 3 teams: ow (owl), oi (coin), ur (turn), ear (hear), air (chair) and er (winter). Your child now has every Phase 3 sound — this story mixes them all, so take it slowly and enjoy the win.

pages.text: Olive the owl sits up in the oak.
pages.illustration: Olive the plum-coloured spotted owl on a branch high in the oak, round and dignified, big amber eyes straight at the reader. Introduce her properly — she has presence.

pages.text: Now it is dark and cool.
pages.illustration: Wide dusk scene of the whole farmyard going blue and cool, lit windows in the farmhouse, the oak dark against the sky.

pages.text: A cow is down at the barn.
pages.illustration: A large gentle cow standing in the yard beside the barn, seen from low down so she looks enormous. Warm brown against cool blue night.
Ned with his head tilted right over, one flipper cupped by his ear, listening intently. The cow drawn small in the distance behind him.

pages.text: The cow has a pair of horns.
pages.illustration: Close portrait of the cow's face with a fine pair of curved horns, breath steaming in the cold air. Detailed, calm, characterful.

pages.text: Pip sees a coin in the soil.
pages.illustration: Pip peering down at a small round coin half buried in dark soil, one bright edge catching the moonlight. Close, low, treasure-hunt feeling.

pages.text: Pip, Ned and Olive will not turn back.
pages.illustration: The three of them at a farm gate at night, looking back the way they came, then facing forward together. Determined little silhouettes.

pages.text: Ned sits down on a chair.
pages.illustration: Ned sitting on an old wooden kitchen chair someone has left in the yard, feet not reaching the ground, entirely at home. Absurd and delightful.

pages.text: It is a dark, cool night.
pages.illustration: Wide winter night: frost on the yard, bare branches, breath clouds, the barn light the only warm thing in the picture.

pages.text: Pip and the owl look down at the cow.
pages.illustration: Closing page: Pip and Olive on the branch together looking down at the cow far below, the whole farmyard laid out beneath them. Peaceful aerial view.
